title: AC1024 AcDbAssocVariable direct DXF encoder
scope: Add a transactional direct DXF record primitive for a fully consumed AC1024 AcDbAssocVariable class-version-2 profile whose EvalVariant is a finite real or signed 32-bit integer. Do not admit the physical mechanical witness while its object-body suffix is unclassified, and do not enable document-level associative output.

physicalSource.wireEligibility: Not eligible: typed known fields are captured, but the full object span is not accounted for and wireComplete remains false.

independentSchema.observation: The prior prefix receipt records independent DXF field order as class version, four strings, value discriminator/payload, has_t78, t78 and b290. The independent schema supports real and signed 32-bit integer EvalVariant forms.
independentSchema.limits: Neither source nor schema explains the physical witness's remaining body bits or establishes associative consumer semantics.

wireOrder: AcDbAssocVariable class version and four strings

refusal: physical or generated records without complete bounded-body status
unqualified output versions or EvalVariant forms
extension dictionaries until their graph edge is source-bound
implementation.routeStatus: Direct dxfRW record primitive only; it is not dispatched by whole-document output and does not promote the physical source profile. P4 graph-planner routing remains open.

focusedTest.result: PASS 1/1; covers ASCII/Binary real and int32 records, exact group/value readback, handle remapping, incomplete/unsupported/xdictionary refusal, unresolved-network refusal, record rollback and corrected retry on the same object.

validation.readback: The test reparses serialized ASCII/Binary bytes through dxfReader and compares the complete ordered numeric group/value projection, including a following sentinel record.
validation.fullSuites: NOT RUN; only the owning focused writer selector was required for this slice.

remaining: Classify and consume the mechanical witness's residual body/handle span before marking it wire-complete. Route the direct encoder through source-bound graph planning, close all required descendants, inspect staged output independently, and verify document-level readback and whole-operation publication rollback/retry.
